value.title: Home-relative diagnostic paths evade portability scans

sections.name: body
sections.value:
Extends public-live-receipts-review-heads: directly scanning an excluded ledger with local-path-check's scanText still misses home-relative locators. LOCAL_HOME_PATTERNS recognizes only absolute user-home paths; operational portability is not a general C21 privacy sanitizer.

For public diagnostic stubs, check home-relative paths outside pij's allowed layout even when no username appears. Report categories and line numbers, not matched paths. A dedicated public-ledger privacy sensor should enforce C21's layout boundary rather than ban legitimate home-relative configuration references.

Evidence: harness/scripts/local-path-check.ts, LOCAL_HOME_PATTERNS and scanText; #278's original docs/difficulties.md:191 finding, resolved by a ledger-only replacement at 7380b7c within round 1. Security output: d4c0c1f.
